gaps.explanation: Re-read pp1-10. Nothing printed is missing and nothing is counted twice (the General Fund columns of Exhibit L are not in detail). Exhibit E (p4) Total Revenues 13,714,038 = General 8,586,771 + Street 2,174,260 + Debt Service 2,370,520 + Other Governmental 582,487. Detail: General Exhibit P (p10) 8,586,771 and nonmajor Exhibit O (p9, incl. Capital Project Fund) 582,487 tie; Street and Debt Service only from Exhibit L (p8, budgetary). Street: 1,039,458 + 69,517 + 160,885 + 713,776 + 341,572 = 2,325,208 vs p4 2,174,260 (schedule 150,948 above; budgetary 'Local Receipts Local' 341,572 vs p4 Charges 209 + Interest 39,226 + Misc 10,350, while Exhibit L Street 'Other Financing Sources' actual is '-' and p4 prints Street Insurance Proceeds 151,140 under other financing, so the budgetary resources include it; therefore the 151,140 is not added). Debt Service: 842,770 + 15,124 + 388,998 + 1,082,441 = 2,329,333 vs p4 2,370,520 (41,187 short). -150,948 + 41,187 = -109,761 = the gap. Detail total 8,586,771 + 582,487 + 2,325,208 + 2,329,333 = 13,823,799 = schedule_total. JSON statement lines equal p4.

p4 Total Expenditures 11,951,394 = General 7,338,019 + Street 1,600,079 + Debt Service 2,238,128 + Other Governmental 775,168. General (pp11-14) 7,338,019 and nonmajor (p9) 775,168 tie. Street: Exhibit L (p8) Streets 1,070,596 + Capital Outlay 524,092 = 1,594,688 vs p4 1,600,079 (5,391 short). Debt Service: Exhibit L prints no expenditure row; all outflows are 'Other Financing Uses' 2,057,754 (in detail, other financing, label as printed) vs p4 Debt Service 124,969 + Lease Payments 11,769 + Bond Payments 2,101,390 = 2,238,128. 5,391 + 2,238,128 = 2,243,519 = the gap. That spending is inside the 2,057,754 line (cannot be split); adding p4 rows would count it twice.

p4 Transfers In 608,733 = Debt Service 321,232 + Other Governmental 287,501 (Capital Project Fund, in detail from p9). Debt Service's Exhibit L (p8) prints no transfer row; its inflows are 'Other Financing Sources' 233,231 (in detail), which holds the transfer money on the budgetary basis and cannot be split. Gap 321,232.

p4 Transfers Out (608,733) = General (355,631) + Street (253,102). General Fund transfers out in detail (pp11-14) 355,632 (1 rounding). Street's 253,102 is in detail as Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Uses' -253,102 (same amount, printed label kept). 253,102 - 1 = 253,101 = the gap. Nothing missing.
